C0435.title: FraudBlocker Identifies and Blocks a Coordinated Carding Attack
C0435.summary: FraudBlocker disclosed that its platform identified and blocked a coordinated carding attack. The attackers used payment forms and transaction flows to test card validity at scale, attempting to identify usable cards and complete abnormal transactions. The case illustrates how carding attacks can use automated requests, repeated small transactions, and traffic from multiple sources to evade single-point blocking.

references.title: How We Identified and Blocked a Coordinated Carding Attack
